description: Get tech story clusters from across the web. Each story aggregates coverage from multiple outlets (TechCrunch, The Verge, NYT, TechSnif, etc.) and includes links to social discussion (tweets, Reddit threads, LinkedIn posts). Sort by rank (prominence) or newest (most recently seen). Optionally filter by headline tier (1=standard, 2=major, 3=top story), publisher name, discussion platform, topic, or a "since" timestamp, and paginate with offset. Use get_story when you need full details or article body text.

has_discussion.description: Only return stories that have social discussion links

limit.description: Number of stories to return (default 20, max 80)

platform.description: Filter to stories discussed on this platform (e.g. "x", "bluesky", "threads", "linkedin", "forums", "mastodon")

publisher.description: Filter by lead publisher name (e.g. "TechCrunch", "The Verge", "TechSnif")

since.description: ISO 8601 date, only stories seen since this time (e.g. "2026-07-01")

sort.description: Sort order: "rank" (prominence, default) or "newest" (most recently seen)

name: get_top_stories
title: Top stories
